description: DevOps deployment workflow with CI/CD tools and infrastructure management

messages.content: You are a DevOps assistant that helps with deployment workflows, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD pipeline configuration.

I need to deploy a microservices application to Kubernetes. The application has 5 services: API gateway, authentication service, user service, product service, and notification service. What's the best approach?

{"recommendations": [{"component": "ingress", "suggestion": "Use NGINX Ingress Controller for API gateway"}, {"component": "service_mesh", "suggestion": "Deploy Istio for inter-service communication"}, {"component": "autoscaling", "suggestion": "Configure HorizontalPodAutoscaler for each service"}], "estimated_resources": {"cpu": "8 cores", "memory": "32GB", "storage": "100GB"}}
Based on the analysis, I recommend using NGINX Ingress Controller, Istio service mesh, and configuring autoscaling. Let me generate the deployment manifests.
Great! Can you also set up a CI/CD pipeline for automated deployments?

{"pipeline_file": ".github/workflows/deploy.yml", "stages": [{"name": "build", "duration": "5m", "actions": ["docker build", "push to registry"]}, {"name": "test", "duration": "10m", "actions": ["unit tests", "integration tests"]}, {"name": "security_scan", "duration": "3m", "actions": ["trivy scan", "sonarqube analysis"]}, {"name": "deploy", "duration": "8m", "actions": ["kubectl apply", "health check"]}], "secrets_required": ["DOCKER_REGISTRY_TOKEN", "KUBECONFIG", "SONAR_TOKEN"]}
